name: Scaffold access for any installation
summary: Design check, erect with a handover inspection hold point, keep it through the work, dismantle after the last trade has finished.

steps.note: Mark the scaffold footprint and ground check
Design check for loads and ties
Permit to erect near live areas
Erect in lifts; handover inspection and tag before first use, then at the agreed interval
Only after the last trade confirms they are finished
Remove tags and clear the area

logic.reason: Dismantle only after the last handover

checks: Weekly inspection and after weather events
references: Scaffolding and access guidance (design, erection, inspection and tagging)
Temporary works procedure guidance (design check, permit to load, permit to dismantle)
